organization: Green Party of Switzerland (Les VERT-E-S / Grüne Schweiz)
description: Elected national president of the Green Party of Switzerland on 6 April 2024 in Renens, taking office on 7 April 2024 as the sole and unanimously elected candidate, succeeding Balthasar Glättli.

role: Member of the Council of States (Conseil des Etats)
organization: Swiss Federal Assembly, for the canton of Geneva
description: Represented Geneva in the upper house of the Swiss parliament, succeeding her party colleague Robert Cramer. She served on the Council and was vice-president of the chamber. She lost her seat in the October 2023 federal election and left the Council of States at the end of the 2019-2023 term.

role: Member of the National Council (Conseil national)
organization: Swiss Federal Assembly, for the canton of Geneva
description: Elected to the lower house of the Swiss parliament on 18 October 2015, becoming the youngest member of parliament at the time. She focused largely on environmental, transport, asylum and civil-liberties issues. She did not stand for re-election to the National Council in 2019, running instead for the Council of States.

role: Member of the Grand Council of Geneva (Grand Conseil)
description: Elected to the cantonal parliament of Geneva in October 2013. She sat on the transport and energy commissions, chairing the energy commission from December 2014, and led the Green parliamentary group. She resigned in November 2015 upon her election to the National Council.
Served as national vice-president of the Green Party representing French-speaking Switzerland, succeeding Robert Cramer.

organization: Green Party of Geneva (Les Vert-e-s genevois-es)
description: President of the cantonal Green Party of Geneva.
Served as a municipal councillor in Le Grand-Saconnex, a Geneva municipality that includes the airport and several United Nations facilities.
Worked as coordinator for the Geneva cycling-advocacy association PRO VELO from 2010 to 2014, becoming a project manager in 2014. She has been a long-standing advocate for cycling.

organization: Versoix Youth Parliament and Swiss Federation of Youth Parliaments (FSPJ)
description: Took part in the establishment of the Versoix youth parliament in 2006 (aged 18) and joined the national committee of the Swiss Federation of Youth Parliaments in 2007/08. She joined the Green Party in 2008.
